description: This file contains functions to generate sample data for an ERP system, including creating opportunities, quotes, material requests, projects, and notifications, primarily for testing or initial setup purposes.

methods.name: make_sample_data
methods.description: Creates sample opportunities, quotes, material requests, issues, todos, and projects, optionally dependent on existing items.

methods.name: make_opportunity
methods.description: Creates a dummy Opportunity document with random items for a given customer.

methods.name: make_quote
methods.description: Creates a dummy Quotation document with random items for a given customer.

methods.name: make_material_request
methods.description: Creates purchase material requests for a list of items.

methods.name: make_issue
methods.description: Placeholder function for creating issues (currently does nothing).

methods.name: make_projects
methods.description: Creates a sample project with tasks, varying based on the domain (e.g., Education).

methods.name: import_notification
methods.description: Imports a notification configuration for task alerts and triggers daily alerts.

methods.name: test_sample
methods.description: Deletes existing notifications, projects, and tasks, then creates sample projects and notifications for testing.
